findings: Mean prediction disagreements increased from 323.0 for g4 to 586.67 for g8.
Amplitude-weighted mean residual was nearly unchanged: 0.000711 for g4 versus 0.000719 for g8.
Amplitude-weighted high-error exposure was nearly unchanged: 0.2362 for g4 versus 0.2377 for g8.
Unweighted high-error exposure was also nearly unchanged: 0.2506 for g4 versus 0.2494 for g8.
interpretation: The much larger g8 prediction disagreement is not explained by materially greater occupancy of the high-residual phase bins identified by the scalar diagnostic. The next test should move downstream to accumulated logit error and decision margins.
next_research_direction: Measure reference-versus-Q.ANT logit error, top-1/top-2 reference margin, and disagreement conditional on margin for locked g4 and g8 models.
limitations: CPU backend only; no photonic hardware performance claim.
Only 1000 test examples were used for activation occupancy, although classification disagreement used the full test set.
